title: Adyghe AI Language Test: instrument, raw data and analysis tool
description: A small, versioned instrument for measuring whether widely used AI chat tools, in their free tiers, can process Adyghe (ady) input and produce semantically adequate Adyghe output. The release contains the frozen seven-question instrument, the coding scheme, the raw answers of five tools, the marking workbooks labelled by two evaluators by consensus, the tables derived from them, and the C# tool that performs the character-level analysis (palochka use, Latin look-alikes, mixed scripts, normalisation form). Licences: instrument, protocol, documentation and result tables CC BY 4.0; analysis code (tool/) MIT. Raw outputs in data/ were generated by third-party AI services and are not covered by these licences.
